tools.name: mcp-vertex_agent_catalog
tools.summary: Unified discovery catalog for loaded tools, versioned skills and actionable proposals. Read-only.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_analyze_project

tools.name: mcp-vertex_auto-agent-selector_auto_evaluate

tools.name: mcp-vertex_auto-agent-selector_auto_recommend
tools.summary: Rank reachable providers for a task and recommend the best-value one (cost↔quality dial + optional pin, measured win-rates). Advisory: you decide.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_auto-agent-selector_auto_record
tools.summary: Record a task outcome (success/failure) for a provider so future recommendations learn which one actually wins.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_auto-agent-selector_auto_run
tools.summary: Plan the cheapest-capable → escalate-up route for a task (run step 1; on gate failure escalate to a stronger provider, within your cost ceiling).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_auto-agent-selector_auto_status

tools.name: mcp-vertex_conventions_conventions_check

tools.name: mcp-vertex_conventions_conventions_classify

tools.name: mcp-vertex_create_project

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_audit

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_check
tools.summary: Offline dependency health: missing lockfile, unpinned ranges, cross-section duplicates.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_licenses

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_list
tools.summary: Inventory the manifest dependencies (name, range, section).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_outdated

tools.name: mcp-vertex_deps_deps_polyglot
tools.summary: List Python/Rust/Go dependencies (pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod) if present.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_diagram_diagram_deps
tools.summary: Render the workspace internal dependency graph as a mermaid flowchart.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_docs_docs_list
tools.summary: Catalogue the project markdown docs (path + title), low-token.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_docs_docs_read
tools.summary: Read one project doc by its workspace-relative path.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_docs_docs_search
tools.summary: [deprecated] Use search_search { roots: ["docs"] } instead.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_drift_check
tools.summary: Diff the current project analysis against the last persisted snapshot — flags new scripts, dropped deps, framework changes and the missing tools they imply.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_env_env_check
tools.summary: Validate a .env file: duplicate/empty/malformed keys + missing required vars. Offline.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_fs_read
tools.summary: Read a workspace-contained file, optionally a 1-indexed line range.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_fs_write
tools.summary: Write a workspace-contained file (path containment + optional atomic+create-dirs).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_get_validation_matrix
tools.summary: Returns the quality-gate commands per scope (how to validate work in this project).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_blame
tools.summary: Per-line authorship for a tracked file (optionally a line range).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_changed
tools.summary: List of changed file paths in the working tree.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_changelog
tools.summary: Conventional-commit changelog + inferred semver bump for a range.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_diff
tools.summary: Diff --stat (optionally staged or scoped to a path).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_log
tools.summary: Recent commits (hash + subject).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_pr_list
tools.summary: List open pull requests (number, title, branch, url) via gh. Opt-in, network.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_pr_view
tools.summary: View a pull request with its CI check rollup via gh. Opt-in, network.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_show
tools.summary: Commit metadata + --stat summary for a ref (no full patch).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_status
tools.summary: Branch + working-tree status (clean flag + entries).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_git_worktree
tools.summary: List existing git worktrees for this repo (read-only).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_i18n_i18n_check
tools.summary: Flag missing keys + placeholder mismatches across locale JSON files. Offline.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_init_config
tools.summary: Derive (and optionally write) mcp-vertex.config.json from the live project — the self-init any MCP client can call.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_knowledge
tools.summary: List knowledge ids/titles, or fetch one entry by id. Lazy: read a doc only when needed.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_logs_correlate
tools.summary: Build a timeline for one taskId or agent and flag long gaps.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_logs_query
tools.summary: Query redacted append-only MCP log events with filters and cursor pagination.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_logs_redact_test
tools.summary: Audit how the shared secret redactor treats a sample payload.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_logs_subscribe
tools.summary: Return recent events in the shape consumed by the logs SSE endpoint.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_logs_tail
tools.summary: Return the newest redacted MCP log events.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_checkpoint_packet
tools.summary: Rehydrate the latest explicit session digest as a bounded continuation packet.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_compact
tools.summary: Distil carried working-state into a compact session digest; drop the noisy tail.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_compaction_check
tools.summary: Check whether the carried context tail is worth compacting now (deterministic).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_export
tools.summary: Export the full note store as a JSON or NDJSON snapshot.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_forget
tools.summary: Delete a note by id.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_import
tools.summary: Import a previously exported snapshot (replace or merge).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_list
tools.summary: List note ids, titles and tags (cheap index; paginated).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_recall
tools.summary: Recall notes by free-text query and/or tags (newest first).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_memory_save
tools.summary: Save (or update) a titled note with optional tags.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_metrics
tools.summary: Per-tool call metrics: calls, errors, latency (ms) and response bytes.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_notification_await_lock
tools.summary: Wait until a task lock is released (or timeout), so agents stop polling agent_lock status.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_notification_notify_status
tools.summary: Lock-release notifier: pushes notifications/message when a watched lock frees, so agents stop polling.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_advise_routing
tools.summary: Score the provider roster for a task and advise which provider to route to (no spend).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_advise_spend
tools.summary: Analyse recorded spend + limit status and recommend non-destructive cost actions (risk-graded).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_bootstrap_providers
tools.summary: Run the provider bootstrap wizard: probe, draft a roster, and return a prose brief + config patch.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_cancel_invocation
tools.summary: Cancel an in-flight invocation by id, applying the per-kind cancellation ladder.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_discover_providers
tools.summary: Probe the host PATH for known provider CLIs and report which are installed vs missing.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_format_handoff
tools.summary: Format a routing decision into a ready-to-run CLI command or curl template (no spend).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_get_quota
tools.summary: Read the per-provider quota snapshot (populated by the bootstrap layer in a later slice).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_healthcheck_providers
tools.summary: Probe each configured provider CLI on PATH and report install/auth/model availability.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_invoke
tools.summary: Execute a task on the best provider (with fallback). Gated by executeApi + a signed confirmation token — never spends silently.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_list_models
tools.summary: Enumerate the merged provider roster with capability profiles and current reachability.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_orchestrator-runner_set_provider_state
tools.summary: Manually override a provider’s availability (e.g. force unavailable until a time).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_overview
tools.summary: Cold-start map: server identity, plugins, all tools, knowledge ids and the recommended next action. Call this first.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_perf_perf_bundle
tools.summary: Measure files matching globs and flag those over per-file / total byte budgets. Offline.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_plan_mcp_project
tools.summary: EXHAUSTIVE plan for a project-specific MCP server (all tools/prompts/skills/agents + tests) and the files to write.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_agent_lock
tools.summary: Claim files before editing, release after (claim/release/status/gc). The write-ownership primitive.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_agent_names
tools.summary: Name the whole agent tree (orchestrator included): assign/release/heartbeat/list/tree/who_uses/gc/reconcile.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_agent_worktree
tools.summary: Isolate a concurrent agent into its own git worktree + branch (create/list/remove). Required when 2+ agents share this repo.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_auto_work
tools.summary: One call → next proposal + a compact ordered action plan (claim → slice → validate → sync → [persist] → release).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_branch_gc
tools.summary: Remove worktrees whose branch is merged into base, clean, and idle (dry-run default; unmerged branches are sacred).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_branch_status
tools.summary: Snapshot every agent/* branch and every worktree: ahead/behind vs base, dirty/untracked counts, out-of-cache flag.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_close_slice
tools.summary: Mark a slice done in its proposal + release its agent lock, then re-sync.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_compact_status
tools.summary: One-call low-token snapshot of the swarm: active locks, queue backpressure and proposal board counts.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_continue_proposal
tools.summary: Next proposal by cascade (mode auto), or a parallel slice plan/claim (modes plan/claim).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_create_proposal
tools.summary: Author a proposal (.md with frontmatter + disjoint ## Slices), validate overlap, write + sync index.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_delegate
tools.summary: Hand a slice to a subagent: assign a name + claim its files, returning a handoff packet.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_get_proposal_workflow
tools.summary: Returns families, locations, naming, rules and the proposal template (as JSON).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_inherit_host_instructions
tools.summary: Audit host-instruction files (in-repo + opt-in ~/ config) into a ready proposal.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_plan
tools.summary: Validate a set of work slices: file disjointness + which are claimable now (parallel plan).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_proposal_adopt
tools.summary: Analyze an existing proposals folder — and with apply:true, bootstrap the canonical store (folders + README + index).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_proposal_board
tools.summary: Orchestrator view: actionable proposals × slices (status/owner) + claimable now.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_proposal_review
tools.summary: Peer-review a slice: submit for review, approve, or request changes — until a reviewer has no objection.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_proposal_transition
tools.summary: Move a proposal to a new status; validated, folder+frontmatter kept in sync.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_proposals_close_plan
tools.summary: Close a `type: plan` proposal. Refuses with a list of blockers until every child proposal, sub-plan, and own slice is done + peer-reviewed.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_round_context
tools.summary: Persisted multi-agent round digest + staleness (forceRefresh recomputes). For resumed swarm work.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_state_health
tools.summary: Read-only swarm health: active locks, queue backpressure (waiterOrphans/threshold) and orphan assignments.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_state_repair
tools.summary: Heal stale swarm state: GC stale locks, expire due queue entries, force-release orphan assignments. dry-run by default.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_swarm_hygiene
tools.summary: Read-only snapshot: rescue candidates (ahead + not merged), GC-eligible orphans, and out-of-cache worktrees.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_sync_proposals
tools.summary: Rebuild the proposal index from the .md files (run after creating/renaming proposals).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_proposals_task_queue
tools.summary: Multi-agent coordination queue: enqueue/dequeue/subscribe/report (waitFor, observe, backpressure).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_quality_get_quality_scopes
tools.summary: List the available quality scopes and their commands.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_quality_quality_cancel
tools.summary: Abort running quality commands (by PID or all) instead of waiting for the timeout.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_quality_quality_run_all
tools.summary: Run every configured quality scope and return one aggregated pass/fail report.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_quality_run_quality
tools.summary: Run a quality scope (lint/test/build/typecheck) and return structured pass/fail.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_rules_apply_rules
tools.summary: Returns a mode-aware plan to make code comply.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_rules_check_rules
tools.summary: Returns, per area, the linter command and resolved configs to validate compliance.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_rules_get_rules
tools.summary: Returns the rules map (per area: framework, configs+typecheck configs project-first), the mode, conventions, and language dogmas.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_scaffold
tools.summary: Generate a tool / prompt / skill / agent / host project / plugin from templates (dry-run by default).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_search_search
tools.summary: Search workspace text files for a query (grep-like, low-token).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_security_security_audit
tools.summary: Run every scanner (secrets + dependency CVEs + licenses) and return one ranked backlog.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_security_security_secrets
tools.summary: Scan source for leaked secrets (keys, tokens, private keys) — offline, normalized findings.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_skill
tools.summary: List the project + active-plugin skills (id, when-to-use), or load one skill body by id. Lazy: read a skill only when you are about to use it.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_status
tools.summary: Live runtime status from every registered status collector (host runtime + core).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_status-marker_close
tools.summary: Return the canonical close-marker line for the given state (+ optional reason).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_status-marker_ping
tools.summary: Health check for the status-marker plugin.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_status-marker_validate
tools.summary: Audit a response: does its last line match the canonical close marker?

tools.name: mcp-vertex_tech-debt_debt_scan
tools.summary: Find tech-debt markers (TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX/BUG/DEPRECATED/NOTE) across the workspace, ranked by severity. Offline.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_test-convention_get_convention
tools.summary: Return the canonical test convention for the workspace (structured + markdown).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_test-convention_scan_drift
tools.summary: Audit specs and sources for violations of the test convention; returns { ok, counts, violations, scannedFiles }.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_test-convention_suggest_spec_path
tools.summary: Given a source file path, return the spec path the convention requires + a starter skeleton.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_test-policy_get_test_policy
tools.summary: Return the active test-writing policy (tdd/tests-after/free/none) with its agent guidance.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_test-policy_set_test_policy
tools.summary: Override the test-writing policy for this workspace (durable), or clear the override.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_usage-tracking_session_hygiene
tools.summary: Report local MCP session age, idle gaps and response-volume pressure.

tools.name: mcp-vertex_usage-tracking_usage_clear
tools.summary: Clear the recorded usage log + summary (requires confirmation).

tools.name: mcp-vertex_usage-tracking_usage_report
tools.summary: Report usage, cost and attributable token savings by provider, plugin, agent, extension or model.

skills.summary: Use before creating an audit proposal to follow the mandatory reading order, evidence bar, and output contract for full repo audits.
Use when running or consolidating audits to follow the tool-level lifecycle, rubric, and ready-versus-done decision flow.
Use when concurrent agents or processes may touch the same files to choose between withFileMutex and agent_lock or agent_worktree.
Use before release-facing commits or bun run release so commit type, derived semver bump, and publish flow stay aligned with automation.
Use when a workspace needs a capability native tools do not cover, to compose a third-party MCP server via catalog, suggest, validate_config, ack, and the lazy ext.<server>.<tool> call proxy.
Use when a tool returns ok:false or a swarm stalls to recover from lock conflicts, corruption, state drift, policy blocks, or timeouts.
Use only when migrating pre-f00016 pNNN proposals so the legacy mapping and required script order stay correct.
Use when several agents share this repo to choose locks, await release notifications, and avoid duplicate MCP reads.
Use at session start to call overview first, read recommendedNextAction, and choose the right preset before touching plugin-specific tools.
Use when adding or changing an mcp-vertex plugin so tools, schemas, state, path containment, and durability rules stay correct.
Use as the compact entrypoint for proposal work when you need the canonical swarm workflow without re-deriving the process.
Use for end-to-end proposal execution: orient, select, claim, implement, validate, close, and sync without polling or hand-editing state.
Use before run_quality or apply_rules to understand command resolution, commandPolicy boundaries, and why a rules plan was selected.
Use when deciding which lint or typecheck command wins; it explains the priority order project, then dogma, then the vendored default.
Use when adding a rules preset, refactoring internals, or auditing the rules plugin so its SOLID boundaries remain intact.
Use when proposals state is inconsistent after crashes or stale locks to diagnose issues and repair queue, claims, and index drift.
Use when the status-marker plugin is loaded to choose the right close state, generate the canonical marker, and validate the final line.
Use as the pointer to the canonical token-budget playbook whenever you need the current guidance for keeping sessions compact.
Use before verbose tools or when context grows too fast to keep sessions compact through compact calls, delegation, and metrics-aware discipline.
Use when adding Astro tabs or brand-marked tabs to reuse the shared Tabs component and brandLogo resolver for public logos.
